M01: Preview is read-only, paginated and limited to unused assets older than an explicit cutoff of at least 24 hours
M02: Every historical revision, original source and durable outbox frame prevents retirement
M03: Retired assets cannot be completed, read or newly referenced; failed references roll back
M04: SQL serializes retirement against attachment; stale previews never authorize deletion
M05: Exact selections retire atomically; immutable retirement survives lost responses and restart
M06: Version 8 upgrades retain history and conservatively date old assets; failed migration rolls back
